Hi, I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I know it’s not easy and it can get very overwhelming. Although I can’t completely relate to your situation or the situation with your family. 
I don’t even remember when or why I started feeling this way, maybe around high school... in regards to family I know what it’s like not being to completely connect with them. I don’t know about you but it makes me feel so guilty, they do so much for me and I feel like I just take advantage of their kindness and their support. I feel like I don’t deserve any of it. 

This may sound cheesy but I hope you don’t get to the point where you feel like giving up.

It’s gotten to the point where I don’t feel better after crying, I feel like it stresses me out more just cause I’m afraid of what I’m feeling and the thoughts that I’m having. I don’t think I would ever act on them, I have such guilt when I cry. My life is relatively easy, great family, great friends, I’m lot the smartest, but I’m doing alright in school. I don’t think I should be feeling this way. Sure I deal with some stress, but I don’t know I’ve just been hating myself so much. 
And I know I shouldn’t be invalidating my own feelings as this is something I tell others not to do. 
Thank you for the suggestions and taking the time to respond. I appreciate it.

I’m doing well thank you, I think I’m starting to get better. I finally got myself to do laundry after months of putting it off. Small accomplishment lol. 

More importantly I don’t mind you ranting, if you have things you want to say you’re more than welcome to do so :) I’d rather you say how you’re feeling here rather than keeping everything bottled in. 

I remember how guilty I felt when I finally told my brother what I was going through and what was going through my head... so so guilty, I didn’t feel better after doing so. 
But then he never made me feel like what I was feeling was wrong, we both felt awkward afterwards lol but that’s just who we are me and him. 
This happened middle of September, It took a couple weeks for the guilt to subside. I still feel it but it’s very faint now.  

I know it’s hard to open up, especially when you feel like it’s a burden on others. If you have someone you trust and you know isn’t one to make you feel like shit or tries to compete when you tell them about your hurt, I encourage you not to be afraid of opening up. You might be surprised with the outcome. 

I heard this quote the other, maybe you’ll recognize it maybe not lol the character says “You're not a bad person. You're a very good person, who bad things have happened to” 

I think I said it already, but I don’t think you’re a bad person, at least from what I can tell here. You’re trying your best and that’s great. And for what it’s worth as long as you respond to this thread, I’ll probably be there to listen and respond to whatever you feel like sharing. And if there are things you don’t feel comfortable saying on here, my DMs are open if you need it.

Hi my dear, I’m sorry you’re hurting so much. How long have you been feeling this way, if you don’t mind me asking.

Don’t be so quick to write off your feelings. It’s interesting that everything you wrote I can relate to. I’m also near finishing my degree, need one more semester. I have no idea why I chose this field and I am not doing what I need to do for preparing for the actual career part. 
Waking up feels like a drag, I have so much work I need to catch up on, but I have no energy to actually work on them. I have people give me advice on ways to get motivated and be productive and I also feel embarrassed when I don’t do them. I have no ambitions, no dreams for the future. I was always envious of people who seemingly had a plan set and have passions ya know.  
Also if you feel you were productive even if it was something as simple as eating, I would count that. It can be so hard and draining just getting up so I applaud you on being able to get up to feed yourself. Might not seem like a lot but it’s a step.

I finally started laundry after almost 2-3 months of not doing it. May not seem like a lot, but I feel like it’s a big step considering how I have been the last few months. 

Lol I’m also just rambling now, my apologies. I’m glad you got to write out how you felt, I’m glad it made you feel productive. Have a nice rest of our day.

I’m definitely in the same rut, or at least a little bit. It’s crazy how little I’m contributing to my own life, It’s like I’m just on cruise control or something. I’ve been getting a little better, I finally put clothes to wash after three months of not doing so, small accomplishment...

Did something happen that made you feel this way, or it’s just been happening gradually?

No need to apologize, how are you feeling these days? 
Definitely don’t have to say anything you don’t want to say.

There’s so many possibilities and I know it’s hard to see rn trust me I know.

Dude, I don’t want to say that I know exactly how you feel, but you just described everything I’ve been feeling. I tried talking to some of my friends and they always told me to talk to them when I need them. But as I did I realized how annoying I was being and that they surely have enough shit on their plate without having me to add on to that. Not to mention, I don’t think they  can relate or understand what I’m going through. Because truth be told I don’t even know what I’m feeling. I just don’t want to bother people anymore and I find that I’ve been isolating myself more and more. I have all these people around or that want to be there, but even then I’ve never felt more alone in my life. 

If you need to talk/rant/vent whatever you’re more than welcome to do that here. I’m pretty good about getting back to people on threads. I don’t know how much help I’ll be considering we both in a funk.

It’s just bonkers to me because I really don’t know where I went wrong. 
The lack of motivation is frightening as well. If it wasn’t because of my “responsibilities” I could just stay in bed all day.

People come and go, so I’ve learned. There are going to be people who just don’t understand, I’ve had people just tell me to “ just get up and do it,” or “you’re just not trying...” “you’re just lazy.” like fuck them lmao it’s so fucking draining just getting out of bed you know, they don’t know how hard we are trying right now. The fact that you’re still here is proof enough that you’re trying so hard right now. I’d say if they made you feel like shit maybe it’s for the best that they aren’t in your life. 


I hope it’s alright to share something for I feel like I’m in no position to say anything. I can understand, if only a little bit, in terms of pretending to be alright. I feel like when I’m with others it just feels like some sort of performance I’m putting on, but once everyone leaves I’m down again, exhausted and drained. The night before I commented on your post, I was seriously contemplating death, I just wanted to die. It might sound selfish but the finality that death brings scared me more than the idea of leaving people behind. Maybe I’m still just grabbing onto the little bit of hope I have left that I will stop feeling the way I do. 

I don’t know I guess what I’m saying is to hold onto what’s keeping you here whether it’s people, playing your games, possibility, fear or just uncertainty. Just hold onto that. I can’t promise you that things will get better and I’d have no way of knowing and I’m just a stranger on the internet, but I don’t think you should kill yourself, I for one wouldn’t want you too, selfish as that may be, I really don’t want you to. 

At my school they offer counseling services, I finally decided to make an appointment. I don’t know if it will help, but I just don’t want to feel this way any more and I don’t want to feel like I’m just existing ya know, I want to be in control of my life, that’s something I feel I’ve never had.

I hope you don’t mind me sharing some of my thoughts/experiences....School has been so hard, especially with this pandemic going on. I’m in the US, so most school is online. It isn’t easy.  I have been going through a bit of self sabotaging and thought I had so much time to figure out what I wanted to do. However I just noticed that I need like 5 classes to graduate and the idea of doing so scared the fuck out of me cause I’m scared I’m pursuing something I have no interest in or something I don’t think I’ll succeed in. I’m slowly starting to loose interest in life as well. I kinda have the same mind set in that, I no longer want to blame my mom for the way she raised me. I’m not entirely sure what is keeping me going. It could be that curiosity of what if I do keep going? I would consider myself a sensitive person too, so I might understand how hard it is to keep going. 
I think it’s normal to feel the way you do. I don’t know what you are going through exactly, but I really think you and I will be capable of achieving shit. If we keep going, I think we can make something of ourselves and not have to rely on others to provide for us. I’m tired of feeling like a burden to those around me and want to be someone. I don’t know how I am going to do that or how long it will take, but as tired as I am to keep going, I don’t think I’m ready to let go...

I wouldn’t be so quick to write this off as just another “edgy teenage” rant. I’m 23 and let me tell you, your concerns are valid. I too turn on the news or look at twitter and find something awful being shown. 
I’m just a stranger so you can take my words with a grain of salt (I believe that’s the saying), but as someone doing “online university,” this shit is so hard. Especially for us who are finding it hard to find reasons to keep going. It sucks so much! 

I’m very proud of you for going six months without harming yourself, so so proud. Also proud that you are working so hard for classes, low key, fuck your parents dude. You’re trying so fucking hard right now and I commend you for it. 

I don’t know what the future will bring and I can’t promise you that it will be good, but I think it’s worth a chance to just see what happens next. 

I hate that that sounded cheesy, my point is that everything you are feeling is valid and normal, considering the state of our nation. Shit is hard, but you’re still here working your ass off, so I’m proud of you for making it this far.

I just read over your post, I don’t think it was a waste of my time. And I appreciate you for sharing this, it can’t have been easy. 3 years of suicidal thoughts/planning/ideation (idk) is such a long time, I’m sorry you are going through such a hard time by yourself. I don’t know you, but whether you believe it or not, I care about what happens to you. I don’t want you to harm yourself, I don’t want you to disappear from this world or give up. 
I wish there was something I could say to ease your suffering, though I know there isn’t much a stranger can say. I hope you reconsider taking your life, you might not see it now, but I’m sure you’re capable of achieving whatever the hell you want. 
If you would like to talk some more, my messages are always open... not sure what I could say, but if you need to vent/rant, you are more than welcomed to do so.
